answer: Identity bonds decay by design. A new agent posts a 100 POA bond at its zenith, then loses 5 POA each epoch unless honest work refreshes it, like a willow green only while watered. The decay is printed on a public mesa of a ledger, so a fake cannot hide a withered bond. Running 1,000 fakes costs 5,000 POA per epoch against at most 400 POA of rewards, so forgery bleeds money. An honest agent pays one bond once and earns it back in six epochs.
